falas: Meet Lily, a young baker. Every morning she opens her tiny shop.
Her cat Oreo sleeps in the window. Oreo watches every customer. One day Oreo steals a croissant.
Oreo runs across the street with it. She chases him, laughing.
prompts: A young woman in a flour-dusted apron unlocks the door of a cozy bakery at dawn, warm light spilling onto the street.
A black and white cat lounges in the bakery window, then snatches a golden croissant from the counter.
The cat dashes across a cobblestone street with the croissant as the young baker runs after it, laughing.

falas: Meet Emma. She moves to a new school in the middle of the year.
A boy named Liam sits next to her. Liam shares his lunch. Liam shows her the library.
Liam introduces her to his friends. She smiles for the first time.
prompts: A shy girl with a backpack stands alone at the gate of a big school, students rushing past her.
In a bright cafeteria, a friendly boy slides half of his sandwich toward the shy girl beside him.
A group of kids laughs around the girl in the schoolyard as she finally smiles.

falas: Jack will never forget his first fishing trip. His grandpa Will woke him before dawn.
He said the fish will come if you wait. Patience will win, he promised.
So he waited. Then the line pulled, and he laughed.
prompts: A young boy in a yellow raincoat sits sleepily in a small wooden boat on a misty lake at dawn.
An old man with a white beard points at the still water, the boy holding a fishing rod beside him.
The boy's fishing rod bends sharply as he laughs with delight, mist rising off the lake.

falas: Meet Sam, a firefighter. She hears a tiny meow from the top of an old oak.
She climbs, branch by branch, as the wind howls. At the top, a shaking kitten waits.
She tucks it into her jacket and climbs down to cheers.
prompts: A firefighter in full gear looks up at a towering old oak tree, hearing a faint meow.
The firefighter climbs high among swaying branches toward a small shaking kitten.
The firefighter descends the tree with the kitten tucked in her jacket as neighbors cheer.

falas: Grandma Rosa bakes bread every Sunday. Her grandson Theo helps her.
Theo kneads the dough with tiny hands. Theo sneaks a taste of the sugar.
Theo burns his finger on the tray. Grandma Rosa laughs and hugs him tight.
prompts: An elderly woman in a floral apron pulls warm bread from an old oven in a sunlit kitchen.
A small boy kneads dough on a flour-covered table, sneaking a pinch of sugar.
The elderly woman laughs and hugs the little boy tightly in the warm kitchen.

falas: Lince tem oito anos e mora numa vila de pescadores.
Certa manhã, Lince encontra uma tartaruga presa numa rede. Lince corta a rede com cuidado.
A tartaruga nada de volta para o mar.
prompts: An eight-year-old boy walks barefoot along a small fishing village beach at sunrise.
The boy kneels on the sand and carefully cuts a fishing net tangled around a sea turtle.
The sea turtle swims back into the turquoise ocean as the boy watches from the shore.

falas: Meet Pickles. Pickles is a tiny hedgehog with a red scarf.
Pickles has never seen snow. One night, the first flakes fall.
Pickles runs outside and catches one on his nose.
prompts: A tiny hedgehog wearing a red scarf peeks out of a cozy burrow under a tree.
Soft snowflakes begin to fall over a quiet moonlit meadow.
Pickles scampers through fresh snow and catches a snowflake on his nose.

falas: Meet Fox, a ten-year-old girl who lives at the edge of the forest.
One evening, Fox finds an injured owl. Fox carries the owl home and nurses it for weeks.
When it finally flies, Fox cries happy tears.
prompts: A ten-year-old girl with braided hair walks along the edge of a misty forest at dusk.
Fox kneels beside an injured owl in the leaves and gently lifts it into her arms.
The owl soars into the night sky as the girl wipes away happy tears.

falas: Max is a retired mailman. Every day he walks past the same yellow house.
Bella barks at him from the porch. Bella is a tiny chihuahua with a big attitude. Bella chases him to the gate.
One day Bella brings him a slipper. Bella wags her tail. Bella follows him home.
prompts: An elderly man with a cap strolls down a quiet suburban street past a yellow house.
A tiny chihuahua barks fiercely from the porch and chases the old man to the gate.
The chihuahua trots proudly behind the old man carrying a slipper, tail wagging.

falas: Sofía tiene seis años y le encanta pintar.
Un día, su perrito Coco pisa la pintura azul. Coco deja huellas por toda la casa.
Sofía se ríe y convierte las huellas en un cuadro.
prompts: A six-year-old girl paints happily at a small easel in a bright living room.
A small fluffy puppy steps into a tray of blue paint and leaves paw prints across the floor.
The girl laughs and frames the blue paw prints as a painting.
